messages:
Maya: quick check: VoiceOver reads duplicates in Vectors Preview when compact rows are enabled. VO reads visible number then an SR-only copy. Screenshot: https://figma.redwood/internal/vec-compact-dup.png
Arjun: confirmed on mac+VO. compact uses stacked spans and we forgot aria-hidden on the visual node.
Lena: also noticed focus jumps to inspector close button before the row content when arrowing into the list. needs fix.
Tom: product preference: default to comfortable, make compact an opt-in toggle with short tooltip explaining tradeoffs.
Priya: perf warning: compact increases DOM nodes per page; we'll CI stress test with large exports.
Maya: suggested toggle copy: "Compact rows 6 Show more items per page (opt-in)" — concise, explains tradeoff. thoughts?
Arjun: implement pattern: SR-only label + aria-hidden on visual value. will open PR and tag team.
Lena: add aria-live polite region for bulk selection announcements (debounced) and use aria-describedby for relevance explanation.
Tom: Maya, can you update Figma to show both row heights and tooltip microcopy so we can run a short usability session next week?
Maya: on it. I'll add checklist and ping when PR lands.
